metadata.height_definition: height_m is the area-weighted average roof height above ground; extrude from base_height_m to height_m. max_height_m is the tallest roof of City massing parts that substantially overlap the footprint; one City part can span a podium and tower mapped as separate OSM buildings, so max_height_m is context, not an extrusion height.
metadata.shadow_definition: shadow_at_solar_noon_m is the flat-ground shadow length at solar noon, ignoring terrain and neighbouring buildings.
metadata.interpretation: Existing heights are City measurements where available and labelled estimates otherwise. Proposal masses are simplified boxes, not designs.
